correctness.rationale: The probability-Haar Peter–Weyl kernel restricts to \(C^{(2)}_{2L-2}(u\cdot v)\), as follows from the SO(3) character formula and Chebyshev derivative. Probability-normalized Funk–Hecke gives all even harmonic eigenvalues and their multiplicities, with zero elsewhere. A positive Fourier cosine expansion of P_{2j+1} establishes strict adjacent eigenvalue gaps. Orthogonal top-degree coefficient gives positive minimal eigenvalue and sharp κ. Rank and nullity are polynomial sums. checker.py independently performs rational polynomial identity/integration/trace checks for \(1\le L\le12\); all-L correctness comes from the provided algebraic proof, not finite enumeration.

originality.rationale: The examined primary full text on rotational Radon inversion averages rotations over SO(2) fibers; the strongest close full SO(3) sampling theorem uses a three-parameter Euler grid. Neither determines the operator restriction to the half-turn conjugacy class, its exact visible quotient, strict ordered eigenvalue law or sharp condition number. A separate compact-Lie-group Fourier restriction paper concerns Lp estimates. Semantic database searches with direct half-turn, alias and equivalence descriptions returned no identified matching or subsuming claim. Broad general trace results could remain unlocated, so this judgment is same-model, not independent certification.
residual_risks: General compact-symmetric-space trace/RKHS literature may contain mathematically equivalent Gegenbauer–Legendre diagonalizations not indexed under half-turn sampling.

value.rationale: Half-turn rotations are a canonical RP² conjugacy class. The output determines exact observable rank and nullity from a cubic-dimensional Wigner band, solves minimum-norm inversion, computes every sharp sensitivity level, and proves nontrivial strictly ordered eigenvalues and \(\kappa_L\sim (2L/\pi)^{1/4}\). These are natural and consequential structural harmonic sampling facts, not routine recomputation of a known numerical table.
